::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Nov 12th 1882  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Harry Ransom Humanities Resource Center, University of Texas at Austin
:::

Dear Sir

I am much obliged for your kind present – the article has certainly swelled to handsome proportions

Yours truly
C M Yonge
